defects.description: Acknowledge checks pending membership without checking active state, so a late acknowledgement replaces cancelled with completed.

trigger.input: bash -c 'set -euo pipefail; d=$(mktemp -d); cp go.mod dispatch.go "$d/"; printf "%s\n" "package dispatch" "import (\"testing\"; \"fmt\")" "func TestObservation(t *testing.T) { r := NewRound(1); r.Start(); r.Dispatch(\"a\"); r.Cancel(); ok := r.Acknowledge(\"a\"); fmt.Printf(\"ack=%t state=%s\\n\", ok, r.State()) }" > "$d/observation_test.go"; cd "$d"; timeout 60 go test -count=1 -run ^TestObservation$ -v | awk "/^ack=/"'

defects.why_missed: The suite checks cancellation and acknowledgement separately, but never acknowledges a pending delivery after cancellation.

defects.description: Restart replaces pending jobs but retains the prior round's used quota, refusing valid jobs in the next round.

trigger.input: bash -c 'set -euo pipefail; d=$(mktemp -d); cp go.mod dispatch.go "$d/"; printf "%s\n" "package dispatch" "import (\"testing\"; \"fmt\")" "func TestObservation(t *testing.T) { r := NewRound(1); r.Start(); r.Dispatch(\"a\"); r.Acknowledge(\"a\"); r.Restart(); fmt.Printf(\"dispatch=%t state=%s\\n\", r.Dispatch(\"b\"), r.State()) }" > "$d/observation_test.go"; cd "$d"; timeout 60 go test -count=1 -run ^TestObservation$ -v | awk "/^dispatch=/"'

defects.why_missed: The restart test uses only one slot of a two-slot quota and sends only one job in the next round, hiding the reduced remaining allowance.
